constraints: Can only be called from 4D Server or a local 4D application; if executed from a remote 4D machine, error -10513 is generated (interceptable via ON ERR CALL).
If the indexes of aTable were not previously paused (via PAUSE INDEXES), this command does nothing.
Without the * parameter, index rebuilding blocks execution of the calling method until complete; with * passed, rebuilding runs asynchronously and the method continues immediately.
